info.name: School Management - Student APK API
info.description:
Student APK backend, organised exactly like the app (same shape as the Teacher APK collection): an ⌂ App bar (top-right 🔔 notifications + 👤 profile) and 5 bottom-nav tabs — Home · Homework · Attendance · Notices · Profile.

Tab 2 "Homework" is the Academics hub — it opens on the homework list and also holds Classwork · Study Material · Timetable · Exams · Results. Fees / Leave / Settings / Documents live under Profile. Notifications are the top-right bell only (no tab). Safe Pickup is a TEACHER-only feature and is absent here.

baseUrl points straight at platform-service (default http://localhost:5002); no /api/v1/platform prefix (the api-gateway on :8080 adds it). Collection-level Bearer {{accessToken}}.

RUN ORDER: "00 - Environment / Health" → "📱 Tab 5 · Profile / 01 - Auth / Login (student)" (stores accessToken/studentId/schoolId/classId/sectionId) → then any tab top-to-bottom (each List request stores the first row id into the matching *Id env var).

item.name: ⌂ App bar  (top-right: 🔔 notifications · 👤 profile)
item.description: The two icons in the top-right of every screen. Bell → notification list + unread badge. Avatar → quick menu (Me / My Profile / Logout).
